1953, February 3
The following is the faithful transcription of the typed and hand- written original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY HUNTINGTON, INDIANA February 3rd 1953.
Blessed be God! In all His designs.
God bless you Jerry Mccarthy; - you and yours. We have been praying for your health-improvement; and although reports were not too good yesterday and today; still we hope this find you improved and improving. At all events dear Jerry, make the best of the situ- ation by offering everything to God in union with the sufferings and joys of Jesus' sacred Passion and victorious Resurrection. Not only that dear Jerry; but let us Thank God ahead of time for how and by what blessings He may see whereby best to answer our pleadings.
I proposed yesterday to Miss Franklyn that we all join in "sort of storming Heaven" for Jerry's speedy recovery, God willing, and that we each make some little sacrifice of somekind. She surely seemed to fall in line with the idea at once. I am sure you will smile some day when she tells you the suggestion proposed. I was surely pleased at her willingness manifested. Sorry I could not talk with your whole Personnel - of whatever denominsyion. I cer- tainly was pleased to meet them as we did have the privilege to do so December 10th last. Glory be to God.
Dear Jerry: I hope this may not have bored any one too much. When we get a little older and we may have a little more leisure I'll have to tell you about my Uncle, another grand (old) Jerry Mccarthy, who died in Neutown, Massachuttes at the age of 104.
God bless you agani Jerry: and that you may profit by this little holdup you are experiencing these days, just try and take the whole thing and all its difficulties as from the hand of the Allwise and Merciful and Gracious God. Thank Him at all times and possibly when you get a little stronger you might think of some little way wherin personally to improve in His privileged service, possibly more frequently to receive if He speed the return of your health and surprise the doctors and your many friends. .. Deo Gr.
Pl. pardon my machine work - am only a novice at it, as yet. Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
